title: Professional Certificate Course in Concepts in Managing and Utilizing Human Resources
description: The aim of this course is to explore the role of team synergies in promoting organizational success.
longDescription: Understand the dynamics of managing a multi-generational workforce. Explain the difference between different generations of the workforce at the workplace. To explain trends and innovation in HR policies. To understand retention strategy and organisational change process. To explore team synergies and their role. In this course, you will learn to understand the unique dynamics of managing employees from different generations, including the differences in communication styles, work preferences, and values. Through exploring the different generations present in the workforce, you will gain a deeper understanding of how to create a workplace culture that fosters collaboration and mutual respect among employees of all ages. In addition, this course will cover the latest trends and innovations in HR policies, from employee retention strategies to organizational change processes. You will learn to develop effective retention strategies that will help your organization retain top talent and drive positive change.
